notes: **Swiftcast**: VZW Refresh cleanings now get the **VZW Refresh screen protector (SKU 101516)** added automatically at checkout, for your commission. Portal credits it back, so the sale stays $0. It's on for everyone; switch it off in Settings → Swiftcast if you'd rather not.
**Swiftcast**: if a cleaning is left half-done (stopped, or something went wrong), an **Open WO** button takes you straight to it. Confirmations now show which spell you're casting.

**Esuna**: the pill on a work order now reads **Swiftcast available**, and once every cleaning is done it shrinks to Esuna's icon. Its buttons say **Swiftcast this**, **Dualcast this** or **Triplecast this**.

**Waymark**: tags now show on Portal's **Work orders list**: one tag beside each customer's name, plus **+N** for the rest, without making rows any taller. Hover a row to add or remove tags right from the list. Optional: a Waymark tag filter next to Portal's filters (off by default). All three are switches in Settings → Waymark.
**Waymark**: fixed tags and Auto-Waymarks sometimes being cleared from work orders that were still open.

**Master's Mend**: Collapse and Hide for today now work on more kinds of announcement boxes. If a box doesn't get the buttons, send a bug report from that page: it now says which boxes are on the page.
**Master's Mend**: scan to open now also works on the **Sales** page (not during a checkout or refund).
**Glamour**: the login page can now have **No picture**: Portal's photo and headline are hidden, leaving just the purple panel.
**Divination**: the target is now the same for every store, so it's no longer in Settings.
Every crystal got fresh wording. When something goes wrong, the message now has a **report a bug** link that sends what happened along with your report.
Patch notes now quote the bug reports each version fixes, with a thank-you to whoever sent them. Keep them coming: **Send Aethernet feedback** in the avatar menu.
Announcements about a fix in a newer version now have a **Check for updates** button (or **Update now** once it's out).

**Swiftcast**: if Portal's server briefly fails a status change (like "Error while fetching service bench details"), Swiftcast now waits a moment and tries again, up to twice, instead of stopping. Status changes are safe to repeat, so nothing is done twice.

**Master's Mend**: announcement boxes on work orders (like "Apple iOS 27 and Repair Mode") get **– Collapse**, which shrinks one to an icon at the bottom left, and **Hide for today**. They never disappear for good: click the icon to bring one back. A new announcement always shows.

**Master's Mend**: scan to open works again. Portal now keeps some hidden dialogs on every page, and Aethernet mistook them for open ones, so it ignored every scan. It also works on **Arrivals** and inventory's list pages now (purchase orders, counts, RMA/buyback and store products), but still never while checking in or out, on a PO, while receiving, or during a count. If a scan still doesn't work, send a bug report from that page: it now includes your last few scans and what happened to each.

**Divination**: link a cleaning to its order by hand. When a cleaning can't be matched automatically (for example, the carrier set it up on the customer's other phone), pick the order from **Link to…** next to it in the cleaning rate panel. The link counts for everyone at the store, in today's rate and the history, and shows who linked it, with **Undo**.

**Swiftcast**: the experimental commission option now adds the right item, the **Verizon Free Screen Protector (101516)**, the same way Portal's checkout does. Portal credits it back, so the sale stays $0. It's still off by default while it's being verified (Settings → Swiftcast).
**Divination**: the Reports page now scrolls when the cleaning rate history makes it taller than the window, so the whole card (and the day-by-day table) can be reached.

**Master's Mend**: Portal's **Support Ticket** and **Enhancement Idea** buttons now fit in: Support Ticket is a normal item in the left menu, and Enhancement Idea sits next to View all under Metrics overview instead of over the calendar. They work just as before (Settings → Master's Mend to turn it off).

**Divination**, **Esuna** and **Swiftcast**: cleanings now find their work order even when the carrier used the phone's *other* IMEI. Dual-SIM phones (most recent iPhones and Samsungs) have two; when the IMEIs differ, a cleaning still links if it's the same phone model for a customer with the same name.

**Divination**: a **Cleaning rate history** card on the Reports page shows your cleaning percentage over the last 7, 30 or 90 days, this month or last month: the overall rate, how many days hit the target, a bar for each day and a day-by-day table.
**Master's Mend**: if Portal's Reports page is stuck loading, a warning explains the usual cause: an ad blocker like uBlock Origin blocks Portal's reports. Turn it off for Portal and reload.

**Swiftcast**: new **experimental** option to add the refresh labor SKU (10156) to Verizon Device Refresh cleanings, for commission. It's still being tested, so it's off by default (Settings → Swiftcast → Refresh labor). If the labor can't be added, the cleaning is still completed at $0.

**Swiftcast**: the old lightning bolt button has been replaced by one button named for what's waiting. With one cleaning it's **Swiftcast** (now with its real icon); with two it becomes **Dualcast** and creates both, one after the other; with three or more, **Triplecast**. Right-click Dualcast or Triplecast to close only this cleaning. A short explainer shows the first time. Dualcast is also in Esuna's list and Divination's panel, and can be turned off in Settings under Swiftcast.
**Swiftcast**, **Quick Synthesis** and **Macrocosmos**: some visual changes to enhance the feel of these crystals.

**Swiftcast**, **Dualcast** and **Triplecast** now keep you from reloading the page mid-cast, so no work order gets left half-done: F5 / Ctrl+R / Cmd+R do nothing until the cast ends, and closing the tab or using the browser's reload button asks first. The box reminds you while it runs.
thanks: **C.Boyd** at Lexington, for the idea for **Divination**'s cleaning rate history!
**C.Pritchard** at Lynnhaven, for the idea for **Swiftcast**'s refresh labor option!

notes: Patch notes: thank-yous and credits now get their own highlight, so the people who help build Aethernet stand out.

New crystal: **Rainbow Drip**. Work-order lists color each row by its status: red for Ready for work; blue for Diagnostics, Work in progress and Quality check; green for Ready for pickup; purple for Need to order, Ready for diag and Repair summary; yellow for Awaiting callback, Awaiting item and Awaiting device. It replaces the **UBIF Status Row Classes** script: if that's still running, you'll see how to turn it off.

New crystal: **Master's Mend**, small fixes to Portal, each with its own switch in Settings. First fix: the ubreakifix logo in the top left is now a real link to the dashboard, so you can middle-click or right-click it to open a new tab.

No more reloading to see changes: a text logged by **Recitation** shows in the WO notes right away, and so do Auto-Waymark nickname changes and cleanings closed out by **Swiftcast**. The page refreshes its data in place.

**Master's Mend**: scan to open. Scan a WO label to open that work order, or an item label to open the item, from the dashboard, the work-order list or a customer. On a WO, scanned items are still added to it, and scanning does nothing on inventory, check-in or check-out pages or while you're typing in a field. Scanners that were a little too slow for Portal's own scan features now work with them too.

**Glamour**: make the login page yours. In Glamour's settings, under **Login page**, choose a picture to replace Portal's photo (best fit: 768 × 871 px, shown in the setting), or fill the whole purple panel with it, and show the Aethernet mark in the bottom-left corner.

**Master's Mend**: sort the Work orders list by any column. Click the arrows beside a column name. Most columns sort across every page; Customer, Device/Issue, Location, Service Outcome, Completed and Created/Cancelled By sort the page you're on (their arrows are underlined).

**Auto-Waymark**: texting the customer from a work order at Ready for pickup restarts its follow-up: the Auto-Waymark (and nickname) moves to 3 days from that day. It only ever moves later, and works whether or not Recitation is on.
**Waymark**: managers can clear a tag straight from the board with the × on it. Everyone else removes tags from the work order as before.

**Master's Mend**: a **Hide auto notes** switch at the top of a work order's notes hides the automatic notes (status changes, check-in logs and the like), and loads every note on the work order, so you see the whole history of what people wrote, not just the first page. Flip it back any time; nothing is deleted.

**Master's Mend**: a **Not contacted** chip on the Arrivals page, next to Portal's own (look for the Aethernet mark on its corner), lists every arrival that hasn't been contacted yet, from every page at once. Click an arrival to open it as usual; any other chip goes back to Portal's list. In Settings (Master's Mend), choose whether it lists all statuses or only arrivals that are still Not confirmed.
Crystals that changed in an update now get a purple **Updated** sheen in Settings, like the yellow one on new crystals.
Settings: **Save & reload** glows while you have changes to save. The **Aethernet has updated!** pill now goes away by itself after 10 seconds (the ring around its ✕ counts down; hovering pauses it).
thanks: **B.Young** at Lexington, for letting us crystallize **Rainbow Drip** from their script!

notes: New crystal: **Lay of the Land** (inventory count check). On an inventory count, a **Missing serials** button shows which expected serials haven't been scanned yet, plus any unexpected scans (not in stock, not a serial, or scanned twice). Filter by category, sort, expand or collapse each item, search, copy the list, or download it as a spreadsheet. It updates as each item is scanned, without losing your place in the list.
**Divination**: its icon now shows in its panel.
Aethernet is now available store by store. If your store doesn't have access yet, you'll see a notice instead, and nothing else loads until it's added.
**Swiftcast** won't create cleanings while the store is closed (after **Close store** in Portal). Open the store first.
**Bountiful Yield** now works on RMA orders too: **Add all RMA parts** in the Add RMA parts popout. It stops if the RMA's line limit is reached.

New: **Send feedback**. Report a bug or suggest something straight from Portal: avatar menu → **Send Aethernet feedback**, or the link at the bottom of Settings. Bug reports can include technical details to help track the problem down (never customer details).
Suggestions that get built are credited here in the patch notes.

Auto-Waymark: if a work order's nickname already has a date in it (like "PS5 SLIM (10/01)"), that date becomes its Auto-Waymark date. Otherwise it's 3 days after it reached Ready for pickup, as before.
Fixed: work orders already at Ready for pickup when 2.14.0 arrived were dated from their last update instead of the date in their nickname. Their Auto-Waymarks have been corrected.
New in Waymark: **Auto-Waymark**. When a work order reaches Ready for pickup, it gets a follow-up date 3 days out, added after end of day (7 PM), next to the customer's name.

While a work order is at Ready for pickup, its **device nickname is just the Auto-Waymark date** (e.g. 10/02) and stays in step with it: pushing the date rewrites the nickname, and typing a later date into the nickname moves the Auto-Waymark to match.
Auto-Waymarks turn amber on the day and red once overdue. **Right-click** one to push it later (+1 day, +3 days, +1 week or a date you pick); **×** removes it for good.
The Waymark icon shows a count of Auto-Waymarks due today (or overdue). Managers get a heads-up from the icon on their first Portal load of the day when any were left open past their due date.
The Waymark board has a new **Auto-Waymark** tab listing them as Overdue, Due today and Upcoming.

New crystal: **Waymark** (work-order tags). Tag work orders for the whole store from **+ Tag** next to the customer's name, and see open work orders grouped by tag from the Waymark button in the header.
Each store has its own tag list with colours, set in Settings → Waymark by store managers, district managers and franchise owners. Anyone can add one-off tags.
Every tag change is logged on the work order (not as a Portal note). Tags and their history clear 7 days after a work order closes.
Aethernet is now about 40% smaller, and its daily update check downloads about 1 KB instead of the whole script.
The installed file is minified. **About** links to the readable source (the same build, unminified).
Fixed: in the first few minutes after a release, **Update** could open the previous version. New versions are now offered once they're fully out.
New: **Check for updates** at the bottom of Settings. If there's a newer version, one click opens Tampermonkey's Update page.
When a new version is out, an **update available** pill appears within about 15 minutes, with an **Update** button.
New: **Aethernet notices**. When the team knows about a problem, a banner under Portal's header says what's wrong and that it's being worked on. Affected crystals are marked in Settings.
If a crystal is misbehaving, the team can pause it everywhere until it's fixed; the banner says which ones are paused.
New: **Patch notes**. Open them from the bottom of Settings; every release gets its own panel with the date and time it went out.
The **Aethernet has updated!** pill now opens these patch notes (Settings stays open underneath).
**Macrocosmos**: the button wears the hotbar macro gear and shows its macro name, **GD Exception**, on hover.
The first time the Macrocosmos button appears, a short explainer points at it, with a link straight to its settings.
Settings can now open straight to one crystal with its settings expanded.
Every crystal now shows its FINAL FANTASY XIV action icon in Settings and About.
The Galaxy Diagnostics pill is now the **Macrocosmos** icon itself, like a hotbar slot: click to file, drag to move.
**Glamour** now switches Portal's own light/dark theme, so theme-specific images (Inventory icons, the Reports banner) match your theme.
**Glamour**: dark themes put Portal in dark mode, so the ubreakifix logo turns white. Your own Portal mode comes back when you pick the Portal theme.
Portal is now written as a proper noun everywhere.

New crystal: **Glamour** (page theming). Pick a preset (Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, Crystarium, Ul'dah, Ishgard, The Void) or make your own from a background, text and accent colour. Previews live; Cancel puts yours back.
Crystals are now named after FFXIV actions: Divination, Esuna, Recitation, Swiftcast, Macrocosmos, Bountiful Yield and Quick Synthesis.
An **Aethernet has updated!** pill appears once after each update.
New crystals get a yellow sheen in Settings until you've seen them.
Each crystal's settings now sit under it in the Crystals list.
Settings sections collapse, and remember which ones you left open.
New subtitle: Restoring the *flow* of NextGen.
New **About** window: version, build time, author, your setup, and the install link to share with another store.
The Aethernet name in titles uses its own wordmark.
New crystal: **Buyback add-all** (now Bountiful Yield). Adds every Apple (TLC) or Samsung/Google (UROC) part in a buyback order's Add buyback parts popout.
Fixed: its buttons no longer need the script removed and re-added before each buyback.
Aethernet's tools are now called **crystals**. Your on/off switches carry over.
**Text → WO note** now works in every browser, including Firefox and Zen: it spots sent texts from the browser's own network log.
Attempted fix for **Text → WO note** on Firefox and Zen (finished in 2.3.2).
New crystal: **Text → WO note** (now Recitation). Texting a customer from a WO adds a note: "<you> sent a text message to <customer>." followed by the message.
New crystal: **WO cleanings pill** (now Esuna). On a work order, shows whether the device has cleanings available or done, with Create for available ones.
Pending cleanings in the cleaning-rate list get a ⚡ to create them, behind a confirmation.
Aethernet now installs from a link and updates itself.
The cleaning rate counts cleanings still waiting in Arrivals, shown as dashed chips.
The cleaning list shows each customer's name instead of the device nickname.

First Aethernet release: one install bundling the cleaning auto-close ⚡, the live cleaning rate badge, the Galaxy Diagnostics exception button and Print all labels, with a Settings menu in Portal's avatar menu.
